Verses.Text:
O Lord my [G]God, when I in awesome wonder
Consider all the [C]worlds Thy hands have made

Then sings my [G]soul, my Savior God, to Thee
How great Thou [D]art, how great Thou art [x2]

And when I think that God, His Son not sparing
Sent Him to die, I scarce can take it in

Blessed assurance, Jesus is mine
Oh, what a foretaste of glory divine
